This is a placeholder for an existing Hugo post. `/author` reads files
like this from `sample_posts_dir` to calibrate rhythm and sentence
structure against the user's existing work. Two to three paragraphs
here would be normal.

If the user has no prior posts, the author skill falls back to the
voice guide alone and uses ISO 8601 for the date format.
